_note: MeshCall ICE server presets. Import this file in the VPS Manager app (Settings → VoIP → TURN / STUN → Import).

presets.name: aahlaad.in (self-hosted coturn)
presets.note: Previously used in MeshCall .env.example. STUN + TURN on aahlaad.in. Replace credential before using.

presets.name: Cloudflare TURN (auto credentials)
presets.note: Requires Cloudflare Calls TURN key. Configure Key ID + API Token in the Cloudflare TURN panel instead.

presets.name: Cloudflare STUN only
presets.note: Free Cloudflare STUN. No relay — will fail if both peers are behind symmetric NAT.

presets.name: Google STUN only
presets.note: Hardcoded in MeshCall since the beginning. No relay — Google runs no public TURN.

presets.name: Open Relay (Metered.ca)
presets.note: Free public TURN. Very limited bandwidth — for testing only.

presets.name: Open Relay TCP/443 (Metered.ca)
presets.note: Same as above but over TCP port 443 — works through strict firewalls that block UDP.
